rationale: The only implementation delta is the algorithm-name copy: the vulnerable version uses an unbounded strcpy, while the fixed version uses strncpy limited to the destination field size. The Logic section says only that the algorithm name and key are copied to the reserved space; it does not specify an unbounded copy, a destination-size limit, validation, or any other behavior unique to either version. The reservation, key copy, key-length assignment, and error return are common to both implementations.
